scope: Input-manifest groundwork only; no image extraction or model fitting authorized.

data_contract.localization: same provider stable actor track and per-frame box as P0; conditional-on-localization benchmark
data_contract.label_policy: copy immutable eligible-index center labels; annotation actions never determine times, clipping, padding, masks or track continuation
data_contract.diagnostic_policy: historical transition/occlusion flags retain their original short-window meaning; annotation flags are diagnostics only, never learned inputs or selection gates
data_contract.inference_limit: Reused development scenarios, not independent confirmation; pretrained dataset overlap remains unknown.

archive.hash_policy: opaque byte stream only; never archive-wide CRC/decompression scan
archive.annotations: exactly the same 42 text members for the 21 primary provider recordings
archive.images: getinfo only for exact nonnegative requested primary JPEG names; no JPEG payload reads

sampling.time_origin: unchanged center source frame; nominal absolute times are source frame / 30, not measured PTS
sampling.asymmetry: first offset -32/30 seconds, last offset +28/30 seconds; center is slot 8, not endpoint midpoint
sampling.boundary_policy: never label-cut, shift, interpolate, clamp, repeat-edge-fill or continue into another track
sampling.negative_frame_policy: retain negative requested frame/time with empty image_member and explicit invalid mask; never request negative JPEG names

preprocessing.crop: dynamic per-frame provider box with context_fraction on each side
preprocessing.missing_input_policy: retain center; represent invalid frames explicitly; extraction may fail closed but must not silently drop rows; probe fallback requires a later fitting lock

missing_policy.prospective_prediction_fallback: short-video anchor for incomplete long clips; exact anchor/receipts/fitting provenance require later execution lock

matched_controls_prospective.repeated_center_reuse: permitted only after proving identical center pixels, preprocessing, model weights and source receipts in a later extraction lock

pilot.selection: ascending SHA256(pilot_domain + sample_id), tie-break sample_id; selection independent of label and predictions
